description: Poll either blueprint generation or full-pipeline generation status. Pass exactly one of auditId or jobId. When the run finishes with a blueprintId, call download_blueprint.

auditId.description: Blueprint generation audit ID returned by generate_blueprint.

customerOrgId.description: Customer organization ID (UUID). Required for partner users accessing a customer org.

jobId.description: Full-pipeline job ID returned by trigger_full_pipeline.

name: get_generation_status
